flags: WATER RE-AUDIT LEAD: stored 'not waterfront', and the old note says so, but RA GIS plots Section F (F09-F38) along a peninsula of 194-acre Deam Lake. On leaf-off imagery F09-F24 are on the lake side about 30-70 m from the shore through a wooded strip; F19-F24 are near the tip and F25-F30 about 40-60 m from the east arm. Sites F13-F16 show grass clearings part way to the water, but I could not see an open apron to the shore. RA tags no family site 'Proximity to Water' (only one shelter is tagged Lakefront). I did not change the value; lakeview or lakefront for Section F needs the audit. All F sites fit: F17 29 ft, the rest 38-60 ft.
